name: workers-caff
description: Hackathon starter: a REST API, a live dashboard, an MCP server and an AI agent, all on one Cloudflare Worker.

MODEL.description: The [Workers AI model](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/models/) that Sid, your agent, thinks with. The default works on the free plan.

CAFF.description: The caff's database: a Durable Object with SQLite that holds the menu, orders, stock and mission board.

CaffAgent.description: Sid, your AI agent. Every chat session gets its own instance.
